halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.description: Kammala aikin yaƙin neman zaɓe ko wasa na 'yan wasa da yawa.
halomcc-your-journey-begins-467ebc6bb3.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Your Journey Begins" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar kammala duk wani aikin yaƙin neman zaɓe ko wasan wasa da yawa.

halomcc-just-getting-started-24ea4c9ab6.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Just Getting Started" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar kashe jimillar maƙiyi ko 'yan wasa 100 a cikin kowace manufa ta yaƙin neman zaɓe ko wasan 'yan wasa da yawa.

halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Nemo sa hannun binary boye.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Don buɗe nasarar "I’m Sorry, Dave" a cikin Halo: Reach cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar nemo takamaiman kwai na Easter wanda ke ba da girmamawa ga David Candland, darektan UI na wasan. Ga cikakken jagora kan yadda ake samunsa:

1. Fara kowane aikin yaƙin neman zaɓe ko taswira masu yawa a cikin Halo: Reach.
2. Dauki wani makami wanda ** bashi da ikon zuƙowa. Misalai na gama gari sun haɗa da Assault Rifle ko Pistol Plasma.
3. Danna maɓallin zuƙowa (yawanci sandar dama akan consoles ko maɓallin da aka keɓe akan PC) zuwa "zoom in" tare da makamin da ba a rufe ba.
4. Duba da kyau a ** kusurwar hagu na ƙasa ** na allo. Za ku lura da layin lambar binary yana bayyana a taƙaice.
5. Wannan lambar binary tana fassara kalmar "Dave" a cikin wakilcin binaryar ASCII.

Ta bin waɗannan matakan da kiyaye lambar binary, zaku buɗe nasarar "I’m Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Balaho’s Most Wanted" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar kawar da jimlar Grunts 100 a cikin yanayin PVE, wanda ya haɗa da Gangamin, Wuta, da Spartan Ops. Abin farin ciki, ana iya buɗe wannan nasarar cikin sauƙi ta hanyar yin wasa akai-akai.

halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.description: Kammala ayyuka 10 ko wasanni masu yawa.
halomcc-where-am-i-0ea732d545.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Where Am I?" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar cika jimlar ayyukan yaƙin neman zaɓe guda 10 ko matches 10 na 'yan wasa da yawa.

halomcc-the-one-percent-088630ade1.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "The One Percent" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar kawar da jimlar Elite 100 a cikin yanayin PVE, wanda ya haɗa da Gangamin, Wuta, da Spartan Ops. Abin farin ciki, ana iya buɗe wannan nasarar cikin sauƙi ta hanyar yin wasa akai-akai.

halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.description: Halo: Reach: Cikakkun lamurra na lokacin sanyi.
halomcc-we-re-just-getting-started-4fd09.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "We're Just Getting Started" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Winter Contingency" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-spoilsport-3dada00509.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Spoilsport" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar kawar da jimlar Jackals 100 a cikin yanayin PVE, wanda ya haɗa da Gangamin, Wuta, da Spartan Ops. Abin farin ciki, ana iya buɗe wannan nasarar cikin sauƙi ta hanyar yin wasa akai-akai.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.description: Tattara yaƙin neman zaɓe 500 ko lambobin yabo.
halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Just A Taste" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar tattara kamfen 500 ko lambobin yabo. Ana iya samun waɗannan lambobin yabo yayin yin yaƙin neman zaɓe ko shiga cikin wasan ƙwararru. Don haɓaka ci gaban ku, mayar da hankali kan kashe abokan gaba cikin sauri da inganci, da nufin samun lambobin yabo na kisa da kisa. Ana ba da shawarar yin wasa akan wahala mai sauƙi a cikin yaƙin neman zaɓe, saboda yana ba ku damar tara lambobin yabo ba tare da ƙarin ƙalubalen manyan matsaloli ba.

halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.description: Halo: Reach: Cikakken ONI: Tushen Takobi.
halomcc-protocol-dictates-action-e8ac811.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Protocol Dictates Action" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Protocol Dictates Action" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Yi wasa mai yawa ko haɗin gwiwa aƙalla watanni 3 bayan wasanku na farko.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Don buɗe nasarar "Stick With It...A Little Longer" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar kunna wasan 'yan wasa da yawa ko wasan haɗin gwiwa aƙalla watanni 3 bayan kun buga wasan ku na farko.

Ba kamar sauran nasarorin ba, wannan ba za a iya buɗe shi ta hanyar sarrafa kwanan watan tsarin ku ba, kamar yadda uwar garken ke tabbatar da shi.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Pillar of Autumn" a cikin Halo: CE a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Pillar of Autumn" daga farkon zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Nasarar "The Guardians Are Coming" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) za a iya buɗe shi ta hanyar saduwa da wata kaddara mai ban mamaki: kashe shi ta hanyar da ta ba injin wasan mamaki. Lokacin da wannan ya faru, wasan yawanci yana nuna saƙon, "You were killed by The Guardians." Ga hanya madaidaiciya don samun wannan nasarar:

1. A babban menu na Halo MCC, zaɓi yakin Halo 2.
2. Je zuwa manufa zaži.
3. Sanya kwanyar scarab a matsayin mai aiki.
4. Load da farko manufa ko wani manufa ka fi so.
5. Yi wasa har sai kun sami makami.
6. Harba bene.
7. Nasara a buɗe!

Idan kun bi waɗannan matakan, zaku sami "The Guardians Are Coming" a cikin tarin ku.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Ku yi yaƙi tare da Chips Dubbo ku saurari maganganunsa na hikima.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Don samun nasarar "My Buddy Chips" a cikin Halo: Combat Evolved a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection, kuna buƙatar cin karo da halayen Chips Dubbo yayin yaƙin neman zaɓe Halo: Combat Evolved. Ana iya samunsa a cikin ayyuka daban-daban, amma 'yan wasa da yawa sun sami nasara kan manufar "The Pillar of Autumn."

Ka ci gaba da raye-rayen jiragen ruwa, musamman a lokacin sashen da sojojin Alkawari suka hau jirgin ku, kuma ku saurari tattaunawa ta musamman ta Dubbo. Nasarar ya kamata a buɗe bayan wannan gamuwa.

Yana da kyau a lura cewa bayyanar Chips Dubbo na iya zama ɗan bazuwar, kuma idan kuna fuskantar matsala wajen gano shi, gwada sake kunna aikin kuma ku ɗauki shi a hankali, tabbatar da kasancewa tare da jiragen ruwa kuma ku saurari duk tattaunawarsu1.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "I Need A Weapon" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Nightfall" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.description: Kashe mai haɓaka 343 a cikin daidaitawa ko wanda ke da wannan nasarar.
halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Bite The Hand" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), jerin gwano don wasa da yawa da kashe abokan hamayya yayin wasannin na yau da kullun. Makasudin na iya zama mai haɓakawa ko kowane ɗan wasa wanda ya riga ya sami wannan nasarar, don haka ci gaba da wasa har sai kun sami kisa mai cancanta. Bidiyon yana nuna ainihin sigar Halo 4 na nasarar, wanda ke amfani da faɗakarwa iri ɗaya.

halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.description: Halo: Reach: Kula da tambarin kamfanin hakar ma'adinai da aka rufe.
halomcc-mind-the-skill-gap-566b495f16.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Mind the Skill Gap" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), akan Tip of the Spear, nemi tambarin ma'adinai na BXR a wurin ma'adinai. Tsaya inda kake da fayyace ra'ayi kuma duba alamar kamfani kai tsaye don jawo nasarar.

halomcc-all-out-of-bubblegum-22bdb2c4d2.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "All Out of Bubblegum" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar tattara kamfen 1000 ko lambobin yabo. halomcc-to-war-5b5e005c5c.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "To War" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Tip of the Spear" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.description: Kammala kowane matakin haɗin gwiwa akan wahala ta al'ada.
halomcc-standard-operating-brocedure-ffb.guideDescription:
Don buɗe nasarar "Standard Operating Brocedure" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar kammala kowane matakin haɗin gwiwa akan wahala ta al'ada.

Hakanan zaka iya samun nasarar "Standard Operating Brocedure" ta yin wasa akan wahalar Jarumi ko Almara.

halomcc-going-bananas-a3478a4999.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Going Bananas" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawar da Brutes 100. Sake kunna haduwar Halo 3 ko Halo 3: ODST wanda ke nuna wannan abokin gaba. Ci gaba da share abokan gaba yayin da kuke aiki ta wasu nasarori.

halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.description: Halo: Reach: Cikakken Dogon Dare na Ta'aziyya.
halomcc-you-flew-pretty-good-ef665babe8.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "You Flew Pretty Good" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Long Night of Solace" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.description: Halo CE: Kammala Gaskiya da Sulhunta.
halomcc-truth-and-reconciliation-3d669bd.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Truth and Reconciliation" a cikin Halo: Combat Evolved a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Truth and Reconciliation" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-delicious-brains-a0b4eb557d.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Delicious Brains" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawar da Tufana 100. Sake kunna aikin yaƙin neman zaɓe na Ambaliyar kamar ɗakin karatu. Ci gaba da share abokan gaba yayin da kuke aiki ta wasu nasarori.

halomcc-into-the-howling-dark-faf89601ca.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "Into The Howling Dark" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawai kuna buƙatar yin wasa ta hanyar "Exodus" manufa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe akan kowace wahala.

halomcc-gruntageddon-bbcb54f8fb.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Gruntageddon" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kawar da Grunts 1000. Sake kunna aikin yaƙin neman zaɓe mai ɗaukar nauyi na alkawari inda abokan gaba suka bayyana cikin ƙungiyoyi. Ci gaba da share abokan gaba yayin da kuke aiki ta wasu nasarori.

halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.description: Halo: Reach: Nemo ni a kulob.
halomcc-front-page-news-951f11d7eb.guideDescription: Don buše "Front Page News" a cikin Halo: Reach cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), same ni a kulob din. Yi amfani da bidiyon don gano alamar ƙasa da kusanci. Idan abu ne, matsa kusa don mu'amala da shi kafin ci gaba cikin yankin.

halomcc-dust-and-echoes-abf0cf7266.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Dust And Echoes" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ɗora Sabuwar Alexandria daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kunna har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Bi alamomin manufa kuma gama matakin don haka bayyananne a cikin Zaɓin Ofishin Jakadancin.

halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.description: Halo CE: Kammala Mai ɗaukar hoto Silent.
halomcc-the-silent-cartographer-463f102f.guideDescription: Don buɗe "The Silent Cartographer" a cikin Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ɗora Kwallan Silent Cartographer daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Ku isa tashar tsaro da farko don buɗe wurin, sannan ku gangara zuwa ga Mai ɗaukar hoto.

halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.description: Halo: Reach: Nemo kuma kawar da ɗayan ɓoyayyun Kwamandan Ranger Elite.
halomcc-what-about-bob-d728d4e4c1.guideDescription: Don buɗe "What About Bob?" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), nemo ku kawar da ɗayan ɓoyayyun Kwamandan Ranger Elite. Yi amfani da bidiyon don gano alamar ƙasa da kusanci. Idan abu ne, matsa kusa don mu'amala da shi kafin ci gaba cikin yankin.

halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.description: Halo: Reach: Samun damar yin hira da rediyon UNSC mai ɓoye.
halomcc-easy-to-overlook-7e6f804af3.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Easy to Overlook" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), shiga cikin voyayyen mai magana da rediyo na UNSC. Fara daga wurin da aka nuna a bidiyon kuma bi saitin sa kafin yunƙurin aikin.

halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.description: Halo: Reach: Kashe Fitaccen Mai Zartarwa kafin ya iya tserewa yayin Tip of the Spear.
halomcc-your-heresy-will-stay-your-feet-.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Your Heresy Will Stay Your Feet" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kashe Elite Zealot kafin ya iya tserewa yayin Tip of the Spear. Yi amfani da makami iri ɗaya, abin hawa, ko matsayi da aka nuna a bidiyon. Idan makasudin yana buƙatar takamaiman bugu na ƙarshe, daina yin lalata da sauran lahani da zarar makasudin ya raunana.

halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.description: Halo 2: Ku yi yaƙi tare da almara Chips Dubbo kuma ku saurari kalmominsa.
halomcc-the-chips-dubbo-46489745e0.guideDescription: Don buɗe "THE Chips Dubbo?" a cikin Halo 2: Anniversary a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kunna Outskirts kuma ku tsaya kusa da Marines yayin da kuke fafatawar buɗe ido. Ci gaba da kiyaye Marine na Australiya da rai kuma kusa da ku har sai kun ji Chips Dubbo yayi magana. Idan ya mutu kafin ku ji shi, sake farawa daga wurin budewa.

halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.description: Kammala ayyuka 50 ko wasanni masu yawa.
halomcc-game-on-7965c0c072.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Game On" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), gama haɗa jimillar mishan yaƙin neman zaɓe guda 50 ko wasanni masu yawa. Kuna iya musanya tsakanin su. Sake kunna gajerun ayyukan yaƙin neman zaɓe ko zauna cikin daidaitawa ta hanyar sakamakon don haka kowane kammala yana rikodin.

halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.description: Halo 3: Ku yi yaƙi tare kuma ku saurari Mutumin. Labarin. Chips Dubbo.
halomcc-can-t-keep-him-down-21a41e0ec7.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Can't Keep Him Down" a cikin Halo 3 a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), yi Halo 3 gamuwa da Marines kuma ku tsaya kusa da Marine na Australiya yayin da kuke ci gaba. Ka bar shi a raye kuma ka ba shi lokaci ya yi magana a lokacin faɗa ko bayan faɗa.

halomcc-this-is-not-your-grave-2625dc7b4.guideDescription: Don buɗe "This Is Not Your Grave" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ɗora Kunshin daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Bi alamomin manufa kuma gama matakin don haka bayyananne a cikin Zaɓin Ofishin Jakadancin.

halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.description: Kammala kowane matakin haɗin gwiwa akan wahalar Jarumi.
halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.guideDescription: Don buše "Brovershield" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), gayyaci abokin tarayya zuwa zauren yakin neman zabe, zabi gajeriyar manufa da kuka sani da kyau, sannan saita wahala zuwa Jarumi. Kasance a cikin rukunin wuta kuma ku gama aikin tare. Kira barazanar kuma kiyaye isasshen nisa don guje wa sauka tare.

halomcc-send-me-out-with-a-bang-3c497f2e.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Send Me Out... With A Bang" a cikin Halo: Reach a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ɗora Pillar Autumn daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Bi alamomin manufa kuma gama matakin don haka bayyananne a cikin Zaɓin Ofishin Jakadancin.

halomcc-cairo-station-d8d931daf5.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Cairo Station" a cikin Halo 2: Anniversary a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kunna tashar Alkahira daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Kare tashoshin da ke kan hanyar zuwa bam, sannan ku isa wurin don kammala aikin.

halomcc-assault-on-the-control-room-f130.description: Halo CE: Cikakkiyar Harin Dakin Kulawa.
halomcc-assault-on-the-control-room-f130.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Assault on the Control Room" a cikin Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), zazzage Assault akan Dakin Gudanarwa daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Yi amfani da motocin a kan hanyar ƙasa kuma ku yi yaƙi ta gadoji zuwa ɗakin Kulawa.

halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.description: Tattara yaƙin neman zaɓe 2,000 ko lambobin yabo.
halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.guideDescription: Don buɗe nasarar "A Pile of Medals" a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kuna buƙatar tattara kamfen 2000 ko lambobin yabo. Ana ba da shawarar yin wasa akan wahala mai sauƙi a cikin yaƙin neman zaɓe, saboda yana ba ku damar tara lambobin yabo ba tare da ƙarin ƙalubalen manyan matsaloli ba.

halomcc-outskirts-cd7a38bbcb.guideDescription: Don buɗe "Outskirts" a cikin Halo 2: Anniversary a cikin Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), zazzage Outskirts daga farkon kowane wahala kuma kuyi wasa har zuwa manufa ta ƙarshe. Bi alamomin manufa kuma gama matakin don haka bayyananne a cikin Zaɓin Ofishin Jakadancin.
